master.prompt:
Create exactly ONE square image (1024x1024).

Style: clean flat cel-shaded 2D game art for a moody side-scrolling industrial prison game, painted for pixel conversion: lineless shapes with NO outline and no line art, every material in at most 3 flat tones (highlight, base, shadow), cool purple-leaning shadows and warm highlights, large crisp angular light and shadow shapes, a bold readable silhouette, no gradients, no airbrush, no texture noise, no dithering, no pixel grid. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no border, no frame, no grid.

Reference image: the attached image is an approved in-game sprite from the same game (in-game steel and rust palette at 1x, retain the new design, ignore the reference characters and labels): match its flat cel-shaded style, outline weight, shading, figure size and position on the canvas; do NOT copy that character's face, hair, outfit, equipment or colours.

Subject: a complete fictional four-wheeled foundry scrap cart for a side-scrolling action game, orthographic side/profile with very slight depth so both near wheels and glimpses of both far wheels are visible; no overhead view, clearly FACING RIGHT: its the bent bumper and the front end of the machine turn toward the RIGHT edge of the image; forward is RIGHT and its back is toward the LEFT edge. A compact squat four-wheeled foundry scrap cart, invented 2D action game enemy. Main silhouette 110:75 width to height, strictly facing screen RIGHT. One low asymmetrical burnt-rust-orange mine trolley with charcoal rails, two large dark near-side wheels and two offset darker far-side wheels on the same pair of axles, no fifth wheel. A crushed steel bumper visibly sticks out on the right/front, broad bent industrial plate with no pointed spikes. In its bed are three chunky angular graphite and rust slabs, one tilted. One clearly visible strapped fictional translucent turquoise Haze reservoir with a rigid dark cage band and three clean turquoise tones toward the front, and a squat red warning lamp on top near the right, dark red rim and small bright coral-red lens with a tiny pale highlight so the red palette ramp survives the pixel finish. No literal explosive apparatus, wires, fuses, motor detail, faces, guns, organic characters, numerals, or text. Level stationary idle on aligned wheels, a stubby right-facing front bumper, full silhouette inside the frame.

Size and position: one single figure, the top of the figure (including hair, headgear, raised weapons and effects) about 35 percent below the top edge of the canvas and its lowest point about 15 percent above the bottom edge (the figure about 50 percent of the canvas height), the body a little left of centre so there is extra empty room on the RIGHT side for forward motion, generous empty magenta margin on every side, nothing touching or crossing the edges. The whole figure is drawn with solid, fully opaque pixels: no transparency, no semi-transparent glow, no soft aura, nothing blended with the background.

Background is pure flat opaque magenta, no ground or cast shadow. Center the full machine with 12-15% padding; no background objects. Use broad matte angular lineless color planes like the supplied game's rusty steel, and a compact readable shape for 75px artwork. The front bumper, red warning beacon and broad cyan reservoir set this design apart from the reference decorative cart.

Background: solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere outside the character, no shadow, no ground, no glow on the background.
